notes: Posted 26 July 2001 with no Coruscant-set cards, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

The post has no separate starting section; it marks starting cards inline: Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Tatooine: Great Pit Of Carkoon, Jabba's Palace: Dungeon, Tatooine: Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Sebulba's Podracer, Start Your Engines! and Power Of The Hutt ('Start... usually'), with Mighty Jabba, Boelo, Mara Jade, Jabba, Chall Bekan, Ephant Mon and Chevin as starting or pulled options depending on whether the opponent plays Profit. All count toward the 60.

Posted 'Xivor' dested Prince Xizor; 'Jabba (Start if Profit)' dested the Special Edition Jabba; 'Chevin' dested the Jabba's Palace character Chevin; 'Scum And Villainy Foil' dested Scum And Villainy (the foil printing).

Jabba's Palace Audience Chamber, Spaceport Docking Bay, Tatooine Docking Bay 94 and Tatooine Podrace Arena dested their Dark pages; Great Pit Of Carkoon and Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand dested the original printings, not the virtual (V) cards.
Sebulba's Podracer is posted under Effects; it is a Podracer, counted in the 60. Secret Plans is an Effect in this era.
